cases.title: Immigration Medical Examination (IME) Record
cases.issuing_authority: Health Canada - Panel Physician Branch / IRCC eMedical

fields.laboratory_results: Chest X-Ray Normal, HIV Non-Reactive, Syphilis Non-Reactive, Serum Creatinine Normal
fields.medical_history_questionnaire: Complete - No relevant medical conditions or risks reported

narrative_blocks: The applicant, Jane Doe, completed a comprehensive Immigration Medical Examination (IME) on 2026-01-15 administered by designated panel physician Dr. Sarah Jenkins (ID: PP-40921) at Metro Health Panel Clinic.

Laboratory and radiological screenings, including chest X-ray and blood tests, yielded normal and non-reactive results. No further medical evaluation (furtherance) was required. The eMedical receipt NZ-1029384756 and IMM1017B form were transmitted electronically to the immigration authority.

cases.title: Immigration Medical Examination (IME) Record - Expired Assessment
cases.issuing_authority: Health Canada - Panel Physician Branch / IRCC eMedical
narrative_blocks: The applicant submitted an Immigration Medical Examination (IME) report completed on 2024-03-10 under receipt NZ-0019283746.
As of the current processing date, the medical examination results exceed the 12-month validity window and expired on 2025-03-10. A new medical examination is required before processing can proceed.

defect_spec.description: The medical examination results were conducted on 2024-03-10 and expired on 2025-03-10, exceeding the maximum 12-month validity period at time of assessment.

cases.title: Immigration Medical Examination (IME) Record - Unauthorized Physician
narrative_blocks: The applicant provided medical examination results issued by Sunrise Family General Practice under Dr. Alan Miller (ID: UNREGISTERED-999).

Verification against the official Panel Physician Network database indicates that Dr. Alan Miller is not a designated panel physician, and Sunrise Family General Practice is not authorized to submit eMedical records.

defect_spec.description: Medical examination was administered and signed by a general practitioner who is not a designated or active member of the official Panel Physician Network.

cases.title: Immigration Medical Examination (IME) Record - Pending Specialist Furtherance
cases.issuing_authority: Health Canada - Panel Physician Branch / IRCC eMedical

fields.laboratory_results: Sputum Culture Pending, Chest X-Ray Inconclusive (Apical Scarring Noted)
fields.medical_history_questionnaire: Incomplete - History of Chronic Cough Requiring Additional Diagnostics

narrative_blocks: The initial medical examination for John Smith identified abnormal chest X-ray findings (apical scarring) necessitating further medical evaluation (furtherance).
The required pulmonology specialist report and follow-up sputum culture laboratory results have not been submitted, leaving the furtherance requirement unresolved and medical assessment incomplete.

defect_spec.description: Medical examination indicates mandatory furtherance requirements due to abnormal initial findings, but required specialist reports and follow-up laboratory results are missing.

cases.title: Immigration Medical Examination (IME) Record - Missing Examination Proof
cases.issuing_authority: Health Canada - Panel Physician Branch / IRCC eMedical
narrative_blocks: The application file lacks proof of upfront medical examination or an eMedical information sheet/receipt at the completeness check stage.
No IMM1017B form or digital eMedical receipt attachment was provided to confirm that the applicant underwent the mandatory medical examination.

defect_spec.description: Mandatory upfront medical examination proof (eMedical receipt, IMM1017B form, and attached document) is completely missing from the submission.
